create_VMapManifolds: create a VMapManifolds instance from a list of geoopt Manifold objects for batched manifold operations
use_vmap_projx: use VMapManifolds projx method to project batched tensors onto their respective manifolds
use_vmap_proju: use VMapManifolds proju method to project batched tangent vectors onto tangent spaces of manifolds
use_vmap_random: use VMapManifolds random method to generate random points on each manifold in the batch
use_vmap_inner: use VMapManifolds inner method to compute inner products of tangent vectors across batched manifolds
